savedAtlas.title: Saved Atlas
savedAtlas.subtitle: Organ coordinates saved from the Zone Map are managed here.
savedAtlas.demoBanner: Atlas zones are stored only on your device. They remain visible during your session and are deleted when you sign out. Real practitioner atlas data is not shown on this account.
savedAtlas.quarantineRemoved: Atlas data of unknown ownership was removed from this device.
savedAtlas.emptyBody: Add organs on the Zone Map and create an atlas with Save.

bulk.scopeNote: Scope: all Saved Atlas organs on this account (regardless of the search filter). The "Organs Without an Atlas" list is not included in this action.
bulk.confirmMsg: {count} atlas record(s) and all their saved zones will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
bulk.quotaFailed: {count} record(s) could not be deleted (device storage is full). No records were changed; the selection was kept.
bulk.partialMsg: {deleted} record(s) deleted. {missing} record(s) not found (they may have been deleted in another tab/device): {list}
bulk.organListTitle: The organ list could not be updated
bulk.organListMsg: Deleted organs may appear under "Organs Without an Atlas"; you can remove them there.

orphans.body: Organs that appear in the organ list but have no saved atlas zones. If they are old/test records you can delete them; if you created them on purpose, you can keep them. Deletion is permanent and will not return from another device.
